heading: ஆங்கில மொழிபெயர்ப்பு
lines: On every bush the slender-tendrilled vine
With blossoms round and white and the golden gourd
Unfold their blooms. The cranes whose feet are green
With plumage soft and red-striped herons too
That after rains arise from whitish sands
That cover dark clay soil, do everywhere
Devour the carps that live in streams and swim
Against the current strong. From the wide expanse
The spreading white clouds send their drizzling drops.
